Criterion: correctness of 5 diagnostic answers and session cost. Agent not stated (isolated fresh sessions, 15.1k baseline tokens) + claude-sonnet-4-6, no extended thinking; single session per format
- Format A human-readable + n.s. + claude-sonnet-4-6: file 8,072 tokens; session 18.9k tokens, 1m36s, 1 tool call, 5/5 correct, 4/5 high confidence. Quality works, cost works
- Format B structured + n.s. + claude-sonnet-4-6: file 7,106 (-12.0%); session 24.0k, 5m24s, 1 call, 5/5, 4/5. Quality works, cost partly
- Format C compressed + n.s. + claude-sonnet-4-6: file 6,695 (-17.1%); session 31.6k (+67.2% vs A), 7m00s, 1 call, 5/5, 3/5. Quality works, cost does not work
- Format D compressed + decoder tool + n.s. + claude-sonnet-4-6: session 28.3k, 4m05s, ~5-7 calls (one execution error), 5/5, 4/5. Quality works, cost does not work

Same 200 events encoded in 4 formats; same 5 questions; same model (claude-sonnet-4-6), fresh isolated session per format, no extended thinking. Baseline: Format A. Acceptance: answer correctness (criteria Not stated). Repetitions: 1 session per format. Human intervention: Not stated

All formats 5/5 correct; human-readable cheapest in session tokens (18.9k) and time; compressed C +67.2% session tokens despite -17.1% input tokens; decoder tool reduces C's cost to 28.3k but adds tool overhead. No statistical test

Distinguished cost, not correctness (ceiling 5/5). Not repeatable as reported (single run per format). Limitations stated: single model, single dataset, crossover point not established; experiment covers data retrieval, not code architecture (proxy gap)

Training distribution paradox (agent-optimal structures underrepresented); Lost-in-the-Middle challenges large files; human reviewer cognitive debt; proxy gap (architectural claims not experimentally validated); single model and dataset. Future: compression crossover, controlled CODEMAP.md evaluation, file consolidation, ceremony-to-logic formalisation, LLM-native language
